about: The communio of the formulary “Mass of the First Sunday after Epiphany” in the 1962 Roman Missal. This formulary serves the weekdays of that week. On the Sunday itself the feast of the Holy Family takes its place.

seg.tr: Son, why have You done this to us? Your father and I were seeking You in sorrow. And why is it that you were seeking Me? Did you not know that I must be in the things that are My Father’s?
